crossRefs.note: I love you, Yahweh, my strength.
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.
My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.

translations.web: To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.
translations.bsb: To You, O my strength, I sing praises, for You, O God, are my fortress, my God of loving devotion.
translations.kjv: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my defence, and the God of my mercy.
translations.asv: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing praises: For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy. Psalm 60 For the Chief Musician; set to Shushan Eduth. Michtam of David, to teach; and when he strove with Aram-naharaim and with Aram-zobah, and Joab returned, and smote of Edom in the Valley of Salt twelve thousand.
